result.topic_en: The closing lines of Euler's paper on a singular kind of series. He says no assignable ratio exists between certain formulas p with various exponents, yet other methods probably exist for summing the series of even orders, even though the three methods given here are insufficient.
result.transcription:
186 MEDIT. CIRCA SERIES SINGVLARES.

items.english: No assignable ratio at all exists between the formulas p^λ, p^μ, p^ν, p^ξ, etc.

items.english: Meanwhile there is no doubt that other methods exist by which series of even orders can be summed, even though the three methods set out here are by no means sufficient.
